name: 일기토
description: Duel Spotlight — a crimson-gold spotlight falls on each survivor while a curtain of crimson flame drops over every other unit and sinks into embers
format: WebP sprite strip (lossy RGB + alpha), straight (non-premultiplied) alpha
card: cost 5 · fire · 내 전장과 적 전장에서 랜덤 유닛 하나씩만 남기고 나머지 처치 (spell.type duel_random_keep)
playModeNote: NEW MODE duelKeep: needs the two survivors BEFORE the fx plays. Pick the kept unit of each side first (same random rule as duel_random_keep), pass their uids to the fx, and resolve with those same uids. Layer 'keep' plays on each survivor (both sides, at most 2); layer 'kill' plays on every other unit on both boards at its own delay. Sides with 0 units are skipped; a side with 1 unit only gets 'keep'.
afterEffect: destroyed units are removed by the game as usual; preview fades each one out at delay+250..450ms

sfx.source: fs2 C-style: synth low brown-noise rumble with rising low-pass (slow amplitude sway) + soft pitch-drop sub thump(s), layered with this concept's own Kling clip audio low-passed ~0.6-0.7 kHz; final low-pass 1.7/2 kHz
sfx.note: low warm swell under the survivors' aura + one heavy low thump when the other units fall
